title: Neural Network Backflow with Low-Rank Multi-Determinant Updates
summary: Simulating strongly correlated fermions remains a long-standing challenge due to the exponential complexity of the Hilbert space and the intricate sign structure of many-body wavefunctions. We introduce a variational framework centered on a neural network backflow transformation that combines deep learning with variational Monte Carlo. The proposed ansatz employs a multi-determinant expansion with low-rank shifts to capture non-local correlations and complex sign structures.
